name: Momentum Fund - The First Donor On The Wall

donors.name: Margaret Chen-Alvarez
donors.note: Gave the week the fund opened, before there was anything to show for it.
donors.why: I got my first board seat through someone I met at a Harvard in Tech dinner. This is how I pay that forward.

momentumSections.body: The donor recognition wall, promoted to the top of the page by an Order edit.

### Harvard in Tech is at an important turning point

We are a volunteer-led alumni community that has grown into a global network of founders, technologists, operators, investors, and professionals.
momentumSections.title: Why Support Harvard in Tech?

description: The day the first gift clears, on the real page, framed on the wall itself rather than the hero: one band, one badge, and no filter chips — a lone All / Leadership Circle pair would filter nothing and only add furniture. The founding line reads in the singular, which is the one day the wall says it. The step between the invitation state production ships today and the populated wall its pair, 'The Donor Wall Moved To The Top', shows at nineteen supporters.
